versioning.versionNameStrategy: semver matching the web release being packaged (e.g. 1.1.0-rc.1)

sdkPolicy: Verify the current Google Play target-SDK requirement at build time and record the resolved values in the release PR. No hardcoded SDK level is claimed here.

intentFilters.note: PLACEHOLDER host. Replace with the owner-chosen domain before release; the assetlinks.json file must be served from that domain.

assets.adaptiveIcon: REQUIRED before internal track: foreground + background layers, all densities
assets.splash: REQUIRED: splash drawable matching web launch screen
assets.notificationIcon: REQUIRED: monochrome small icon for push notifications

lifecycle.note: Verify background/foreground restore, session expiry surfacing, and offline/reconnect indicators on a real device per on-device-test-plan.md.
